description: A shell script used for verifying various aspects of the Kubernetes codebase, including running checks, excluding certain tests, and managing test execution modes.

methods.name: is-excluded
methods.description: Checks if a given file is in the list of excluded patterns.

methods.name: is-quick
methods.description: Checks if a given file is in the list of quick checks.

methods.name: is-explicitly-chosen
methods.description: Determines if a test is explicitly selected based on the TARGET_LIST.

methods.name: run-cmd
methods.description: Runs a verification command and logs the output, handling silent mode.

methods.name: print-failed-tests
methods.description: Prints the list of failed tests.

methods.name: run-checks
methods.description: Executes verification checks matching a pattern, with support for exclusions and quick mode.

methods.name: missing-target-checks
methods.description: Checks for invalid or missing target tests.
